proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 4205 article gives Malayalam pin backside, behind, after; other; pinnē behind, after, yet, then, consecutively; pimpu the backside, rear; back, behind, after; piṟaku the backside; after; piṟṟa next day; puṟam the back..
